verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes concrete German entity-formation guidance (GmbH/UG foundation starter kit, notary questionnaires) and a webinar explicitly framed around 'key features and differences to other jurisdictions,' showing some comparative jurisdiction content. However, there is no evidence it covers Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, or Indian Pvt Ltd specifics — its scope is Germany-centric (offices only in Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich). Missing for 10: explicit guidance comparing Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, and Indian Pvt Ltd structures, and any published decision framework for choosing among them.
